integrity: The infinite theorem follows by digit-block symmetry; CHECK.py supplies finite integer corroboration, not an infinite proof. Independent audit has not occurred.
scientific_limitations: Only simultaneous palindromes in dependent bases b and b cubed are classified; this does not assert analogous formulas for other power ratios or for primes in the family. An earlier equivalent result might exist.
title: Exact length laws for palindromes in bases \(b\) and \(b^3\)
